runs.name: dish-check-squeeze
runs.description: the squeeze / stretch tool: books exact, contents kept

evals.js: const a = moire.sample(); const r = await moire.dish.scale(0.8); const b = moire.sample(); return JSON.stringify({notes: r.notes, exact: r.exact, line: moire.dish.line(), alive: [a['cells.alive'], b['cells.alive']]})
const r = await moire.dish.scale(0.8); return JSON.stringify({notes: r.notes, line: moire.dish.line()})
const r = await moire.dish.scale(1.25); return JSON.stringify({notes: r.notes, line: moire.dish.line()})
const r = await moire.dish.scale(1.5625); return JSON.stringify({notes: r.notes, line: moire.dish.line()})
